behavior_coverage: Single and side-by-side tables associate by observed header anchors; field order can vary, tables and repeated headers replace previous schemas.
Explicit continuation markers on consecutive pages reuse the previous schema; field evidence retains the actual current page.
Headerless item anchors separate multiple items, including a missing left result with a present unit; empty cells never shift neighboring fields.
Missing results retain raw_value empty, STATUS, SEARCH_ONLY and association_conflict; multiple value cells and boundary ambiguity preserve source text and remain SEARCH_ONLY.
Low-confidence OCR rows, header mappings and specimen/panel context degrade with versioned reasons; phase-two dictionary context is explicitly supplied in new tests.
Raw names, values and units remain original; numeric, comparator, qualitative, semi-quantitative and reported status values remain distinct.
Decimal-comma/letter-zero/full-width character repairs remain before/after candidates, never silently applied; superscripts preserve exponent semantics in unit candidates.
Each available field has independent OCR evidence; page-level or missing region evidence uses precision page and polygon null, including full-page merged spans.
Explicit observed specimen/panel labels provide dictionary disambiguation with specimen evidence; missing or unreliable context is not inferred from a unit.
Existing public extraction and candidate APIs remain; candidate extraction now follows table boundaries and includes semi-quantitative labels.
Partial headers recognize explicit trailing units and omit unknown footer-only rows.

interfaces.extract_observations: Existing signature preserved; ExtractedObservation adds default specimen, field_evidence, quality_issues, normalization_candidates, reference_range.
interfaces.missing_result: raw_value="", result_type="STATUS", capability_level="SEARCH_ONLY", quality_issues contains association_conflict; pipeline/model support coordinated with root.
interfaces.field_evidence: {field: {page_number: int, polygon: coordinate pairs or null, precision: region or page}}; absent fields explicitly use page evidence.
interfaces.quality_issues: {code, rule_version, fields, details}; layout rule version lab-layout-v2, normalization candidate rule lab-normalization-v2.
interfaces.candidate_repairs: {field, before, after, rule_version, reason}; reviewable candidates retain raw content.
interfaces.diagnostics: Retained uncertainty is carried in extracted candidate observations and source_text. Discarded non-item prose and orphan values remain in stored OCR; OCR/page failures remain pipeline-level outcomes.

private_cache_smoke.selection: Exact source hash and OCR cache SHA256 from frozen baseline manifest

remaining_concerns: No manually annotated accuracy claim: private cache smoke checks execution and aggregate candidate counts only; ambiguous and original-only reports remain in evaluation denominator.
Cross-page schema inheritance conservatively requires an explicit continuation marker; unmarked continuations use local headers or headerless parsing.
Context vocabulary is a bounded explicit specimen/panel lexicon; unseen context text remains unresolved instead of guessed.
Header association uses observed horizontal anchors; unusual merged cells and shifted alignment can require review. No general OCR table-structure model is introduced.
Separate source documents and failed OCR attempts must continue to be counted by the root evaluation/pipeline because extraction receives only OCR pages.
